entry.summary: Southwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to settle on the road Saturday afternoon and especially Saturday evening. 2 to 4 cm could accumulate near the summit, and 1 to 2 cm is possible down to around 800 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow lowers down to 500 metres through Saturday morning and early afternoon. 1 to 3 cm could accumulate above 600 metres with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to affect the road Saturday morning and early afternoon. 3 to 5 cm may accumulate above 600 metres with lesser amounts down to 400 metres.
